top_signals.title: US-China Truce Extended as Xi Gets Rare Welcome From Trump
top_signals.summary:
President Trump greeted Xi at Joint Base Andrews, a break from protocol that gives Beijing a powerful visual opportunity to present China as an equal peer to the US. The state visit happens after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced the US and China have agreed to extend their trade truce by two months.

Original filename: Xi visiting US Sept 24 - LIVE.mp4 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Mining Giant Rio Tinto Plans to Expand Metals Trading Business
top_signals.summary: Rio Tinto Group plans to expand its marketing operations to trade more metal from other producers as well as derivatives, according to people familiar with its strategy, as part of a drive by its new leader to make the business more agile.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
